tuition.note: Per academic year, Bachelor of Business Administration, students from outside EU/EEA/Switzerland, academic year 2027-28

requirement.text: Higher education entrance qualification and documented English proficiency (IELTS Academic 6.0; scores older than 2 years not accepted); passport copy, financial plan, motivation letter and CV in English, official transcripts. International priority deadline 1 March, final 1 June for non-EU/EEA applicants.
